heading: Bring a useful reference to your Pittsburgh haircut consultation
body:
A reference photo is a starting point for a conversation about shape, texture, maintenance, and the result you want. Bring a few images showing what you like, then explain the detail that matters: the outline, movement, fringe, length, or finish. Two photos can look similar while requiring different styling habits.

Describe how your hair behaves on an ordinary day and how much time you want to spend styling it. Mention recent color or chemical services, growth patterns you find difficult, and what has or has not worked in previous cuts. An honest description of the routine is more useful than planning around a finish you would not recreate at home.

Before the service begins, discuss the amount of length to remove, the styling work involved, and the plan for growing or maintaining the shape. Confirm the current appointment type, pricing, timing, and availability through the booking channel rather than assuming every reference fits the same service.

Use the haircut and stylist-selection guides on this site to prepare the questions. The goal is a shared understanding of the result and the routine needed to maintain it.
